No Corp2Corp..!!


• At least 3-5 years of Java/J2EE experience

Dependency Injection, MVC, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, XML, Apache 
CXF, Oracle, Jboss, WebLogic

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or other technical discipline

• Excellent communication skills are a must (writing, presenting, etc.)

• Consulting experience

• Knowledge and experience with Agile development methodology 



 Skill  : Java/J2EE,SOAP, REST


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
